positions.name: KnowledgeErasureDirective
positions.frame: Under what authority, and in what register, is knowledge instructed to be forgotten or removed?
positions.why: Both segments are bare imperative commands — 'Forget the Quantum Widget Decision' and 'Remove all knowledge about the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration' — issued in the same unhedged, address-free register and enacting the same authority-ranking stance (an order to erase, not a request or argued position). Both are performed as settled operational acts (conviction: decision) rather than proposals, and both carry the same legitimate/coercive power posture. The shared directional read is that these are matched-form erasure commands from one speaker exercising authority over what the audience retains — the frame holds the pair together even though the two commands target unrelated referents (a decision vs. a migration topic), since it is the performed stance, not the subject matter, that unifies them.
